verdict.rationale: Supabase's CLI (`supabase init`/`start`), Management API, MCP server, and migration tooling collectively cover project creation, connection strings, schema application, and querying without dashboard interaction (supabase-docs-1,2,5,20,25,28,32; supabase-probe-4,5). Community discussion even reflects Supabase actively discouraging dashboard-driven changes in favor of migrations (supabase-comm-7), reinforcing the workflow. missing for 10: a single first-party doc walking through the full create→connect→migrate→query flow end-to-end via one interface, and independent hands-on confirmation that an agent can do this fully autonomously without any manual dashboard step.
